NQ.es: giro alcista de dia 1 tras el shock del viernes; hoy vigila si el retest de 29278-29363 sostiene (confirma) o si pierde 29278 (reabre el corto). Estructura de swings todavia sin confirmar el giro.
NQ.en: day-1 bullish turn after Friday's shock; today watches whether the 29278-29363 retest holds (confirms) or loses 29278 (reopens the short). Swing structure still hasn't confirmed the turn.

ES.es: rompio su tesis bajista de 3 dias el viernes; hoy vigila el retest de 7642-7660 como soporte. Sesgo fusionado cerro debil, exige confirmacion real antes de subir conviccion.
ES.en: broke its 3-day bearish thesis Friday; today watches the 7642-7660 retest as support. The fused bias closed weak, needs real confirmation before conviction rises.

GC.es: rechazo limpio en el golden 4432-4453 el viernes, el mas fuerte del ciclo; hoy sin zona tactica cerca de precio, pura zona de valor (POC). Vigila si un 5o intento alcista completa lo que el 4o dejo a 8pts.
GC.en: clean rejection at the golden 4432-4453 zone Friday, the cycle's strongest; today has no tactical zone near price, pure value territory (POC). Watch whether a 5th bullish attempt completes what the 4th left 8pts short.

YM.es: unico indice que no confirmo su propio giro de marco (el marco diario propio en bajista) pese a seguir el precio del resto del complejo; hoy es el mas fragil de los 3 indices si NQ/ES pierden su retest.
YM.en: the only index that hasn't confirmed its own frame turn (own daily frame bearish) despite following the rest of the complex's price; today it's the most fragile of the 3 indices if NQ/ES lose their retest.

CL.es: cerro exactamente sobre su propia bisagra de decision (98.57-100.04) tras el whipsaw mas violento del ciclo; hoy sin sesgo de sesion claro, vigila cual lado rompe primero.
CL.en: closed exactly on its own decision pivot (98.57-100.04) after the cycle's most violent whipsaw; today has no clear session bias, watches which side breaks first.
